summary: Fixes for Bluetooth pump problems, mainly Omnipod DASH and Medtrum Nano: the minimum AAPS version for Android 16, Bluetooth battery optimisation, revoking the Android "Nearby devices" permission from other apps, and turning on Bluetooth bonding in the DASH settings on Android 15. Most steps are in Android's own settings; their labels (Security and privacy, Permission manager, Don't allow) are Android's, not AAPS strings.

sections.heading: Android 15 Frequent Bluetooth connection problems
sections.summary: On Android 15 only, turning on Bluetooth bonding in the Advanced Settings of the DASH pump settings, opened from the pump screen's gear icon, then restarting the phone.
